findings.title: Reconfirm withdrawn or conditional acceptance
findings.observation: An earlier yes stays valid after seller hesitation, denial, or a newly required spouse.
findings.action: Bind acceptance to the latest relevant seller turn. Invalidate on hesitation, withdrawal, new decision-makers or conditions, then request fresh exact-price consent.

findings.title: Do not erase liens or unpaid taxes
findings.observation: Qualified no answers are saved as zero additional debt.
findings.action: Parse the whole answer before matching an initial no. Unknown amount must remain unknown, require clarification and block unsupported contract readiness.

findings.title: Unify contact-stop handling
findings.observation: Webhook opt-out parser misses polite stop wording; analysis disagrees on mixed STOP/callback language.
findings.action: Use one durable stop policy at ingestion and dispatch. Some lower layers already hold replies; reproduce cross-channel suppression before claiming any unwanted call occurred.

findings.title: Recover and replace viewing availability
findings.observation: Clarification cannot recover earlier unclear/withdrawn state in the same call; a later correction can leave the old slot published.
findings.action: Store revision-aware availability. A later valid replacement supersedes earlier uncertainty; an unparsed correction clears old slots and requests clarification.

findings.title: Keep busy sellers in the callback flow
findings.observation: Not now, call me tomorrow is marked declined by the text validator.
findings.action: Prioritize explicit later availability over a temporary busy phrase. Reconcile with the SQL scheduling hold and acknowledge the saved next step.

findings.title: Finish seller-to-buyer viewing follow-through
findings.observation: Request capture and follow-up copy exist; completed contact and return-to-buyer automation were not found in the reviewed flow.
findings.action: Create tracked ask-seller, await-reply, relay-options, await-buyer-choice and confirm-access work with cancellation and failure recovery.

findings.title: Support multiple seller signers
findings.observation: Automatic seller contract flow requires soleOwner=true and builds one seller signer.
findings.action: Add the verified multi-signer preparation path or explicitly assign the human task, track all signers and resume only on completed signatures.

findings.title: Define no-answer and interruption recovery
findings.observation: Initial response and requested callback exist; a complete bounded no-answer cadence was not found.
findings.action: Separate no-answer, voicemail, busy, technical failure and unknown outcome. Save a permitted next step with deduplication and stop/takeover checks.

findings.title: Define fresh lower-price acceptance
findings.observation: New quote uses the calculated ceiling; accept_offer must equal the quote. Lower saved agreements work.
findings.action: Choose an explicit negotiation policy and save an authorized proposed price below the ceiling with seller evidence, then accept that exact revision.

findings.title: Handle common payoff and representation wording
findings.observation: No-debt wording can remain unresolved; contradictory agent-agreement wording can be classified unlisted.
findings.action: Clarify ambiguous representation and recognize equivalent debt-free answers without clearing other debt or authority holds.

findings.title: Repair baseline tests before using a green release claim
findings.observation: Two of 24 existing suites fail: a fixture omits signatureRequestMessage, and a source-text assertion expects obsolete prompt wording.
findings.action: Update the isolated test fixture and assert current behavior. These failures do not by themselves establish live contract failure.

findings.title: Verify real conversation quality and handoff completion
findings.observation: Local deterministic checks cannot demonstrate latency, interruptions, actual message receipt or completed human transfers.
findings.action: Run controlled full conversations across voice/SMS with real timing, provider receipts, signing sandbox and handoff acknowledgements.
